quality.note: Regional curated tsunami observations v1 (v6.7 C batch): three events inside bundled regional bathymetry grids — 2010 Maule (cl-megathrust), 2015 Illapel (cl-megathrust), 2016 Kaikōura (nz-aotearoa). NCEI/ngdc.noaa.gov and PTWC are unreachable from the build network (probe 2026-10-01: 000), so every value is curated from open-access primary documents listed in each event's sources and read directly at curation time: Vargas et al. 2011 (Andean Geology open HTML), GEER Section 14 report PDF, Heidarzadeh & Satake 2017 (open CC-BY PDF), Satake & Heidarzadeh 2016 review (open PDF), Omira et al. 2016 (Coast. Eng. J., abstract verified), the GeoNet event story page and the NOAA/PMEL NCTR event page. Range values are frozen at their range midpoint with the range kept in the record note (e.g. Dichato 6-8 m -> 7 m). Tide-gauge values are zero-to-crest amplitudes as published; runup values are field-survey maxima — the two types are NOT interchangeable and are scored per-type. forecastAreas are intentionally absent: regional warning-area classification scoring stays a Japan-only scorecard for now (the regional area registry is an app-side construct, not a frozen observation set). 1960 Valdivia / 1908 Messina / California far-field events are out of scope of the regional grids and not curated.
